sampling: latest newly closed candle at each hourly collection; omitted candles are not backfilled
price_reference: last closed 5m price known at registration; differs from historical primary-close entry
first_outcome_candle: first complete 5m candle opening after recorded_at
rules: symmetric ATR target/stop first touch; both touched in same 5m bar neutral; gaps pending
multiple_comparisons: One exploratory XRP30m follow-up; selected after 150 historical tests; cannot establish generalization to other assets
limits: Not active until frozen model and capture are verified. No retroactive forecasts. Nonoverlapping episodes need not be independent. No profitability claim. Original and alternative protocols remain frozen. Historical 83.02% is exploratory.
episode_rule: Merge all accepted overlapping 24h windows transitively per engine; primary outcome is earliest registered signal per episode, independent of its result; all directions included
